jobs.how: Write BV 33 = 1 and keep it on while the chiller should run; the EX2 input must also be closed. Check BV 1 for the real state, since the keypad has the same priority.
Write points are write-only, so read the current values from the matching read points. Stay within the printed ranges.

points.use: Write upper setpoint (entering CHW full load), 45-80 °F
Write lower setpoint (leaving CHW full load), 35-70 °F

jobs.how: Read entering and leaving chilled and condenser water temperatures in °F, plus current demand against design load.

points.use: Read: current load versus design load

jobs.how: Points exist for 24 compressors; AV 1 says how many are installed. Read per-compressor status and temperatures, and set lead compressor and stage delay through the write points.

points.use: Read: lead compressor (first on, last off)
Read: delay between compressor starts/stops, s

jobs.how: Map the live system fault bits and the count of compressors in fault. Per-compressor fault values are coded numbers; decode them with the manual's fault tables.

points.use: Read: number of compressors in fault
Read: EX1 input fault, manual reset
Read: EX3 input fault, manual reset
Read: EX4 phase monitor fault, auto reset
Read: low chilled water flow fault
Read: low condenser water flow fault
Read: failed-compressor share that trips alarm, %

jobs.how: The 20-entry fault review rotates; AV 154 says which slot is newest. Each slot has a type code and a compressor number (0 = system).
Ten read-only AVs log run hours in 10 % load bands, useful for checking how the plant is loaded.

checklist: Check the portal-to-COMPU25 RS-232 link (2400 baud 8N1, 50 ft max, jumper set to RS-232) and set the DIP switches with 3 and 4 ON, 1, 2 and 5 OFF.
Connect the portal's 10BaseT port to the BACnet IP network; defaults are IP 192.168.1.101, mask 255.255.255.0, UDP 47808, network number 6100.
Discover device 610001 and confirm instance numbers by discovery, since the manual text and Table 3 disagree for some points.
Verify reads of AV 1 (num_of_compressors_1), AV 5 (echw_sys_temp_1), AV 6 (lchw_sys_temp_1), BV 1 (on_off_ctrl_read_1) and BV 3 (remote_on_off_1).
Confirm the EX2 input is closed (BV 3 = 0), write BV 33 (on_off_ctrl_write_1) = 1 and watch BV 1 and AV 2 (capacity_1).
Write AV 135 and AV 136 within range and read them back on AV 11 and AV 12, since write points cannot be read.
If the chiller is stopped at the keypad, BV 1 goes off while BV 33 stays on; write BV 33 off briefly, then on, to restart.
Map AV 4 and BV 2, BV 4-BV 8 as alarms, decode fault codes with the manual's tables, and note that most system faults need a reset at the COMPU25.
